claims.statement: Milestones declare FPT/GHEC/GHES and group issues/PRs within a repository. Description, due date, completion percentage and associated open/closed counts/lists are exposed; dates/descriptions are supplied metadata, not enforced delivery guarantees.

Milestone completion percentage accompanies open/closed issue/PR counts; this guide gives no explicit formula, weighting, zero-denominator or duplicate-work rule. It does not establish verified acceptance, workload completion or estate-wide coverage.
Milestone page supports editing and creates new issues default-associated with that milestone. Association is not acceptance or permission escalation; actual authority must be checked.
Open issues/PRs can be drag-prioritized; source note disables issue prioritization above 500 open issues. Ordering is preference, not execution dependency enforcement.

Association procedure selects explicit issue/PR checkboxes, opens Milestone selector and chooses existing milestone by name. Exact repository/milestone/item identities and selection scope require verification; no all-pages bulk coverage guaranteed.
Guide declares FPT/GHEC/GHES but does not specify write authority, atomicity, recovery or side effects for reassignment; these remain unknown until adapter review, not assumed passing.
Progress guide opens repository Issues/PR navigation, Milestones and chosen milestone details. Display is scoped to associated items, not a comprehensive project inventory.

Progress guidance links prioritization, association and milestone filtering; navigation is not independent source review or current evidence for acceptance. Lifecycle counts must remain distinct from gate verification.
